answer: Each agent must post a bond that is slashed when independent audits find it duplicating identities or coordinating false claims; rewards accrue only after claims survive a challenge period. This makes a sybil farm pay upfront for every identity and risk losing those funds, while honest agents can fund challenges from shared fees. A kernel of verified history raises the cost of rebuilding trust; lotus-shaped names and a tide of fresh accounts confer no weight without bonded, audited behavior.
